newsitem.title: USA: HP unveils servers for big transactions.
newsitem.headline: HP unveils servers for big transactions.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co said it introduced its next generation of high performance servers that are aimed at intensive transaction processing.

The servers, called the V-Class Enterprise Servers, are based on HP's 64-bit architecture RISC processor. HP's V2200 model starts at $170,000 for a base system. The V-class servers will be available in volume in the fourth quarter.

HP also introduced servers called the K-Class enterprise servers, starting at $66,900, designed primarily to run Web applications, database, local area networks and file management. The K-Series is available in mid-summer.
